## Recall · Lecture 7

a) Which layer of a mobile OS runs directly on the hardware?
b) Which package does an iPhone install?
c) Who decides when a game asks for the microphone?

::: {.answer}
a) the kernel
b) an .ipa
c) the user, when the OS asks for a permission
:::

## Activity 1 · Version and updates · 10 min

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}
- Android shows its version and security patch in Settings › About phone.
- An iPhone shows its iOS version in Settings › General › About.
- Android phones get updates from their maker, and Apple updates all supported iPhones at once.
- **Do it:** Find the version of your phone. Does the maker's update page still list your model?
:::
::: {.column width="50%"}
![](images/versions-updates.png)
:::
::::

## Check 1 · Version and updates

What does a good answer show?

::: {.reveal}
1. It names the place in Settings, for example Settings › About phone › Software information.
2. It gives the version, for example Android 14 with the patch date 2026-08-01.
3. It takes the update fact from the maker's page, because another phone may be another model.
:::

## Activity 2 · Permissions · 12 min

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}
- Pocket Quest asks for the location, the microphone, the notifications and the contacts.
- The test lasts one day, has no voice chat, and checks the daily reward message.
- **Do it:** Fill the table with the answer on P5 (Android) and on P8 (iPhone), with a reason for each.
:::
::: {.column width="50%"}
![](images/permission-dialog.png)
:::
::::

## Check 2 · Permissions

Which answers fit the test?

::: {.reveal}
1. The location gets Only this time on P5 and Allow Once on P8, because the map is needed for one test.
2. The microphone and the contacts get Don't allow, because the game does not need them.
3. The notifications get Allow, because the test checks the reward message.
:::

## Activity 3 · Power and focus · 10 min

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}
- The power-saving mode lowers the CPU speed and often the frame rate.
- Do not disturb stops calls and notifications during a test.
- **Do it:** Find both switches on your phone. In Power Lab at 20 %, what are the frame rate and the play time, with power saving off and on?
:::
::: {.column width="50%"}
![](images/power-modes.png)
:::
::::

## Live demo · Power Lab

{{< sim file="sims/power-lab.html" poster="sims/power-lab.png" title="Power Lab: battery saver, Do not disturb and a game" task="**Show:** turn on Do not disturb, then lower the battery to 20 % and turn power saving on. **Ask:** which setting makes the test unfair, and why?" >}}

## Check 3 · Power and focus

What does Power Lab show at 20 %?

::: {.reveal}
1. With power saving off, the game runs at 60 fps for about 48 minutes.
2. With power saving on, it runs at 30 fps for about 1 h 20 min.
3. So a fair test keeps power saving off, charges the phone and turns on Do not disturb.
:::

## Game challenge · Two Phones

{{< sim file="sims/two-phones.html" poster="sims/two-phones.png" title="Two Phones: Android and iPhone side by side" kind="game" task="**The story:** Rami prepares the test of Pocket Quest on P5 (Android) and P8 (an iPhone). **Play:** choose the right step on each phone, from the version to Low Power Mode." >}}

## Try it · Two Phones (harder)

The facts: P5 is an Android phone whose security patch is a year old. P8 is an iPhone, and it asks for Low Power Mode at 18 % during the test.

a) Where does Rami check if P5 still gets updates?
b) What does Rami answer when P8 asks for Low Power Mode?
c) Which phone calls the location answer for one time Allow Once?

::: {.answer}
a) on the maker's update page
b) No, and he charges the phone.
c) P8, the iPhone
:::

## Wrap-up

- You can find the version and the security patch of a phone and check its updates.
- You can answer the permission questions of a game on Android and on iPhone.
- You can prepare a phone for a fair test with power saving off and Do not disturb on.
- You can compare how Android and iOS show versions, give updates and name their switches.
